en.headline: CLP first-half earnings rise 6.6% to HK$6.0 billion
en.dek: The power utility reported total earnings of HK$5,997 million for the six months to June, with operating earnings before fair value movements up 9.7%, and declared an unchanged second interim dividend of 63 HK cents.
body: CLP Holdings said its total earnings for the first half of 2026 rose 6.6% to HK$5,997 million, while operating earnings before fair value movements increased 9.7% to HK$5,733 million, supported by steady Hong Kong regulated operations, improved portfolio results and cost optimisation.

Consolidated revenue remained broadly stable at HK$42,856 million. The board declared a second interim dividend of HK$0.63 per share, unchanged from a year earlier. Results also reflected a gain from the divestment of the Jhajjar Power Station in India.

The company said it continued to engage on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan, supporting long-term energy security and infrastructure for projects including the Northern Metropolis, while offering a special summer fuel rebate to customers.

zh.headline: 中電上半年盈利升6.6%至近60億元
zh.dek: 中電控股公布上半年總盈利59.97億元，按年升6.6%，計入公平價值變動前營運盈利升9.7%，派第二期中期股息每股0.63港元，與去年相同。
body: 中電控股表示，2026年上半年總盈利上升6.6%至59.97億港元，計入公平價值變動前營運盈利則升9.7%至57.33億港元，主要受惠於香港受規管業務的穩健貢獻、其他業務組合盈利改善及企業成本優化。
綜合收入為428.56億港元，大致維持平穩。董事會宣派第二期中期股息每股0.63港元，與2025年相同。業績亦包括出售印度哈格爾電廠的收益。
公司表示持續參與本港首個五年規劃討論，支持長遠能源安全及北都等基建項目，並向客戶提供特別夏季燃料費回贈。
